description: This Swift source file defines data structures and functions for handling configuration schema nodes, UI hints, and path segments, facilitating parsing and accessing hierarchical configuration data with schema validation and metadata.

classes.name: ConfigPathSegment
classes.description: An enum representing a segment in a configuration path, either a key (string) or an index (integer).

classes.name: ConfigUiHint
classes.description: A struct holding UI hints for configuration options, including labels, help text, order, sensitivity, and placeholders.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: A struct representing a node in a configuration schema, capable of parsing raw JSON-like data, providing schema validation, property access, and traversal.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a dictionary of raw UI hint data into a map of UI hint objects.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the UI hint corresponding to a specific configuration path, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path points to sensitive data such as tokens or passwords.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Generates a string key for a configuration path by concatenating its key segments.
